page.layout: One page of text, single column, no margin notes. Top: a printed ornamental band. Then a full-width title "DE TRADITIONIBVS.", an introductory paragraph, a second ornamental band, a centred heading "THESIS I.", and a run of numbered theses set as short paragraphs, each with its number on its own line. Bottom right: catchword and signature.

main_text.head: DE TRADITIONIBUS.
main_text.p: In proximis sex disputationibus de verbo Dei σωτ-ἐιβάπ[?]μος[?]: quibus conjuncta est controversia de Traditionibus, de quibus jam, σὺν Θεῷ, acturi sumus: & quidem ita, ut primò de iis in genere, deinde in specie de Papisticis traditionibus tractemus.
main_text.head: THESIS I.
main_text.p: TRADITIO,(ut in Ecclesia hoc nomine utimur) est quævis institutio, quæ in Ecclesia traditur. Græcè παράδοσις[?].
Eaq; PRIMO' est vel dogmatum vel rituum.

Traditio dogmatum, est institutio de fide vel de bonis operibus. Hoc sensu usurpatur traditionis nomen 2. Thessal. 2.15. Nempe igitur, fratres, perstate & retinete traditiones, quas edocti estis sive per sermonem, sive per epistolam nostram. & 2. Thessal 3.6. Denunciamus autem vobis, fratres, in nomine Domini nostri Iesu Christi, ut subducatis vos ab omni fratre qui inordinatè incedit, & non secundum traditionè, quam accepit á nobis.
Traditio rituum, est institutio de observandis certis in Ecclesia ritibus.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Greek word in the introduction, spanning the line end after "σωτ-", is not clearly legible and is marked [?]. The Greek word after "Græcè" is marked [?]. "Eaq;" is read as "Eaque" from its abbreviation mark. Ornamental bands and the decorative initial T are not text. The initial T is joined to "RADITIO" as "TRADITIO". "DE TRADITIONIBVS." is given with V as U in capitals, per the spelling rule. Page furniture: page number 315 at top right; no running head, since the page opens a division. Catchword "Perpe-" and signature "A 2" at the foot. The Roman numerals II to V are bare numbers and are set as paragraphs, not headings.
